misconfig_patterns: License-gated install left in pre-license state with admin-init open
GraphQL introspection enabled exposing full schema (users, teams, runs, artifacts)
/admin reachable without auth before first admin account is created (first-user-wins)
Backing object store (S3 / GCS / MinIO) world-readable for artifact storage
MYSQL connection string embedded in env exposed via /healthz or k8s probe leakage

active_probe.false_positive_check: GraphQL response must include __schema introspection result with wandb-specific type names (e.g. User, Project, Run, Artifact)

deployment_tells: /graphql responds to GraphQL POST without auth header
/admin reachable when no first-user has been created (signup-gate-open)
Helm chart at github.com/wandb/helm-charts / wandb-local image tag local-N
Backing bucket name visible in /api responses or in artifact URIs
pivot_paths: POST /graphql {viewer{username,email,apiKey,teams{...}}} -> account + API-key disclosure if auth-off
POST /graphql {projects{name,entity{name},runs{name,config,summary}}} -> run names, hyperparameters, dataset paths
Run config / artifact URIs -> S3 / GCS bucket pivot, dataset disclosure
/admin first-user-wins -> persistent admin claim if signup is open
